papers.title_en: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ranran Huang, Wenjing Bian, Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Krystian Mikolajczyk
papers.evidence: 提出快速前馈三维高斯重建与像素空间生成式解码
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角三维重建在观测间隔大、需要视角外推时，回归式预测难以表达场景不确定性；既有生成方案还可能受到潜变量压缩及两阶段误差传播影响。PixGR将轻量像素空间生成融入前馈三维高斯重建，缓存上下文观测形成的场景表示，并以此条件化目标视图解码，通过可微渲染和流匹配实现端到端训练。实验显示，它在困难稀疏视图设置下优于回归方法，推理耗时低于一秒，且可与更重的预训练生成模型竞争。该框架探索了兼顾生成能力与效率的三维重建路径。
papers.abstract_en: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/pixgr/.

papers.title_en: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
papers.authors: Ziang Zhang, Wenyou Yi, Zehan Wang, Jiachen Xu, Xintong Han, Chunchao Guo, Zhou Zhao
papers.evidence: 由单张图像进行三维场景构建与几何重建
papers.tldr: 单图三维场景重建需同时恢复物体形状与布局，但现有端到端方法在细粒度几何和资产质量上仍有不足。Easy-3Dfy将物体生成与场景布局估计解耦，分别利用专用生成器和三维基础模型，并通过基于RPF的对齐器匹配物体局部网格与场景局部点图以恢复布局。在Scene-Maker和3D-FUTURE200上，该方法无需完整场景级监督，仍在多项几何指标上持续优于SAM-3Dfy。结果表明，显式几何组合能够兼顾高质量物体资产与空间理解，并分别受益于两类模型的进步。
papers.abstract_en: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. We propose Easy-3Dfy, a compositional workflow that decouples object generation from scene layout estimation, allowing specialized models to fully exploit their respective strengths. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. Without requiring complete scene-level supervision, the proposed workflow consistently outperforms SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics on Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200. Our results demonstrate that explicit geometric composition can effectively combine high-quality object generation with strong spatial understanding, while enabling the workflow to benefit independently from advances in both 3D object generation and foundation models.

papers.title_en: Complementing DINO Features with Image Structure for Part Discovery
papers.authors: Samyak Rawlekar, Nikhil Chowdary Paleti, Amey Gupta, Narendra Ahuja
papers.evidence: 利用视觉变换器特征发现并划分物体语义部件
papers.tldr: DINO等自监督视觉Transformer具备丰富语义特征，可用于前景分割和部件发现，但基于特征聚类的部件边界往往不够精确。研究发现，固定补丁网格产生的跨边界补丁混合了不同部件信息，导致特征熵升高、分配置信度下降。为避免重新训练大型模型，Part-DINO借助低层图像分割边界划分区域，在区域内汇聚DINO特征并聚类发现部件。该方法无需训练，在CUB、CelebA及两个PartImageNet基准上优于免训练基线，并可与弱监督和无监督方法竞争，说明几何结构能有效补足语义特征。
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) like DINO encode rich semantics, enabling training-free segmentation of objects from the background and discovery of their parts via feature clustering. This paper focuses on part discovery: partitioning a foreground object into semantic parts. Existing approaches produce imprecise part boundaries. We trace this to the rigid ViT patch grid used in training DINO, where patches straddling boundaries contain pixels from multiple parts. While DINO's invariance-based training could absorb this pixel-level mixing into clean features, experiments with over 26K foreground patches show it does not: boundary-overlapping patches produce features with higher entropy and lower assignment confidence, blurring predicted part boundaries. Rather than make the massive effort of retraining DINO over geometrically coherent regions, an easier approach is to take boundaries directly from a boundary detector, which supplies the geometric information DINO's features lack. Motivated by this, we introduce Part-DINO, a training-free framework that combines boundaries from low-level image segmentation with DINO's semantic features. We use the boundaries to partition the image into regions, pool DINO features within each region, and group them to discover parts. Without any training, Part-DINO produces structurally coherent part assignments, outperforming training-free baselines across four standard benchmarks (CUB, CelebA, PartImageNet-OOD, PartImageNet-Seg) and remaining competitive with weakly-supervised and unsupervised methods.

papers.title_en: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Dong-hwi Kim, Chaewon Moon, Hojun Song, Dongbeom Kim, Junyeong Jang, Aro Kim, Gahyeon Kim, Heejung Choi, Jehee Kim, Gianella Cravioto, Sohyun Lee, Gyeongjin Choi, EunHye Jeong, Soo Ye Kim, Jaehyup Lee, Sang-hyo Park
papers.evidence: 多视图图像恢复旨在维护几何一致性并改善三维重建
papers.tldr: 现实三维重建常依赖有损压缩的多视图图像，不同视角的压缩伪影会破坏几何一致性，影响特征匹配、相机估计与新视角合成。为此，论文提出CompMVR，以扩散模型联合恢复多视图，并结合学习到的压缩先验和跨视图对应关系，在补足视觉细节的同时提升几何可靠性。多数据集、编解码器及压缩等级上的实验表明，该方法改善图像恢复，并提升新视角合成、位姿估计和视图匹配。研究由此指出，面向三维重建的压缩多视图恢复值得作为独立问题研究。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked. In this work, we identify compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a critical failure mode, where view-dependent artifacts disrupt feature matching, dense correspondence, camera parameter estimation, and downstream 3D reconstruction tasks such as novel view synthesis. To address this problem, we propose CompMVR, a compression-aware multi-view diffusion restoration framework that jointly refines compressed views while preserving cross-view consistency, and construct compressed datasets for systematic evaluation. Unlike conventional restoration methods that optimize each image independently for 2D perceptual quality, CompMVR leverages learned compression priors and cross-view correspondence to recover visual details while improving geometric reliability across views. Experiments across diverse datasets, codecs, and compression levels demonstrate gains in restoration quality and downstream 3D tasks, including novel-view synthesis, camera pose estimation, and view matching. These results establish compressed multi-view restoration as a distinct problem and highlight its importance for 3D reconstruction under lossy compression. Code and data for this paper are available at https://mchaewon.github.io/CompMVR-project-page/.

papers.title_en: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
papers.authors: Yuhan Liu, Lianhui Qin, Shenji Wan
papers.evidence: 生成可供具身智能体学习的仿真室内环境
papers.tldr: 具身智能体需要在多样、可信的室内环境中训练，但语言规划难以精确落实空间关系，视觉生成结果也常缺乏可执行的三维几何。SceneBloom先用扩散先验在功能分区内采样家具布局，再由契约引导的编译器提取关系、拟合几何并校正局部姿态。五类房间评测中，它的视觉质量和物理稳定性领先，未检出网格碰撞或越界物体，布局也最接近真实房间分布。用其场景训练的物体导航策略，在未见真实扫描环境中的成功率高于使用同等数量真实扫描训练的策略，体现了合成场景对具身泛化的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult. Visual generative models offer rich priors over plausible arrangements, yet their outputs require geometric reasoning to become physically valid 3D scenes. We introduce SceneBloom, an agentic framework that combines visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation. A hierarchical sampler uses diffusion priors to generate furniture arrangements within functional zones. A compiler then uses relations extracted from each proposal to guide geometric fitting and local pose correction. Across five room types, SceneBloom attains the highest visual quality and physical stability among the compared methods and is the only method with no detected mesh collisions and out-of-bounds objects. Its layouts are also closer to the distribution of real rooms than those of all compared baselines. Object navigation policies trained in these realistic scenes achieve a higher success rate in held-out real scans than those trained on an equal number of real training scans. Code is available at https://github.com/Tinaliu0123/scenebloom.

papers.title_en: ACE-Brain-0.6: Scaling Spatial Grounding for Physical Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yinhe Wang, Tao Tao, Zexin He, Shuang Luo, Wei Mao, Yao Mu, Feng Pan, Hanming Deng, Lewei Lu, Zhi Hou, Xingang Pan, Dahua Lin, Dacheng Tao, Xiaogang Wang
papers.evidence: 以机器人操作数据训练空间定位，服务具身操作中的场景理解。
papers.tldr: 通用多模态模型展现了具身操作能力，其空间感知有助于在视觉干扰中定位任务相关实体；但如何增强这一感知基础仍值得研究。研究构建统一数据流水线，整合机器人操作记录与多源视觉数据，并将自动标注结果转化为可验证的定位监督。以约150万条样本微调Qwen3.5-9B，得到ACE-Brain-0.6，在七项公开基准中的四项超过GPT-6 Astra，平均分为75.41，对比其73.68。结果显示，扩展多样且可验证的定位数据能够提升开放式9B模型的空间感知，支持更通用的具身操作。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, demonstrate broad capabilities in embodied manipulation. Our analysis indicates that this generality is accompanied by strong spatial perception, as Astra can determine where to interact with task-relevant entities amid visual distractors. Because spatial perception connects high-level reasoning to the physical scene, we investigate scaling visual grounding to strengthen the perceptual foundation of general embodied operation. We develop a unified data pipeline that combines robot manipulation recordings with complementary visual data from diverse sources. After automatically annotating the robot recordings, the pipeline converts the collected data into verifiable grounding supervision. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on approximately 1.5 million samples produced by this pipeline yields ACE-Brain-0.6. The model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on four of seven public grounding benchmarks, with an overall average score of 75.41 compared with Astra's 73.68. Under a fixed Qwen3.5-9B fine-tuning setup, aggregate grounding performance improves steadily as successive data releases expand the training collection to cover a broader range of grounding scenarios. These results show that scaling verifiable grounding supervision from diverse sources can strengthen the spatial perception of an open 9B model for general embodied operation.

papers.title_en: PnP*: A certifiable solver for Perspective-n-Point
papers.authors: Bang-Shien Chen, Caitrin E. Eaton, David M. Rosen
papers.evidence: 从二维—三维对应点求解相机位姿，属于几何视觉位姿估计
papers.tldr: 从三维点与二维图像对应关系估计相机位姿的PnP问题，常用方法要么仅求解最小问题，要么改用较易优化的替代目标，难以直接求解实际最大似然估计并认证全局最优。论文提出PnP*，通过证明中等噪声下凸松弛精确，并借助弦图稀疏结构和商环约化降低计算规模。实验显示其兼具稳定性与可扩展性，能以每秒超过10次的速度输出可认证的正确位姿。该工作为PnP最大似然估计提供了首个实用且具稳定性保证的全局求解器。
papers.abstract_en: Estimating a camera pose from 3D-2D correspondences - Perspective-n-Point - is one of the most fundamental problems in computer vision. Existing methods either solve a minimal problem or replace the objective with an easier one. Surprisingly, no scalable certifiable solver for the actual Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) exists. We propose PnP*, the first practical solver that guarantees efficient computation and returns a certifiable globally optimal solution. We prove that the underlying convex relaxation is exact under moderate noise, which to our knowledge is the first stability guarantee for any relaxation for the MLE of PnP. Furthermore, we reduce the relaxation by exploiting chordal sparsity pattern and quotient ring reduction such that the relaxation is tractable and scalable. The stability and scalability results are verified numerically, as PnP* returns a provably correct camera pose at over 10 Hz.

papers.title_en: CityLift: Compositional 3D Urban Generation from a Single Image
papers.authors: Haoran Gong, Jie Feng, Chenxu Wang
papers.evidence: 从单张图像生成包含建筑网格和空间布局的三维城市场景。
papers.tldr: 从单张城市图像恢复可编辑三维街区，既要补全被遮挡建筑，也要推断其尺度与位置；透视歧义和配对数据稀缺，使几何质量与空间布局难以兼顾。CityLift联合学习场景布局和建筑形状，先在共享坐标系中构建稀疏支架，再用生成式空间继承引导流模型细化建筑网格，并将其放回原位。论文构建了含4,997个合成场景及实例标注的CityLift-5K，并在该数据集与其他街区数据上验证方法。实验显示建筑几何和场景构图均有改善，为单图生成空间协调、可编辑的城市三维场景提供了组合式方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generating editable 3D urban scenes from a single image requires detailed building assets with a coherent spatial arrangement. Occlusion and perspective ambiguity make it difficult to infer complete building geometry together with consistent relative scales and positions. We present CityLift, a framework that generates individual textured building meshes from an urban image by coupling scene-level spatial modeling with building-level synthesis. CityLift first learns building shape and placement jointly through coupled scene and instance streams, producing coarse sparse structures in a common coordinate system. We then introduce generative spatial inheritance, which maps each building's coarse occupancy and scene-conditioned 3D feature field into a local volume to guide a flow model that generates finer structure. The same coordinate mapping places the generated meshes back into the scene, preserving their spatial relationship to the scaffold. To address the scarcity of urban data pairing scene images with individual 3D buildings, we construct CityLift-5K, comprising 4,997 synthetic scenes with instance masks, building meshes, and placement annotations. Experiments on CityLift-5K and scene blocks from UrbanScene3D and InstanceBuilding demonstrate improved building geometry and scene composition. The project page is available at https://ranhaogong.github.io/CityLift/.

papers.authors: Sarah Zhang, Zhiyang Dou, Minghao Guo, Benjamin Tod Jones, Wojciech Matusik
papers.evidence: 以物体中心表示和Transformer实现三维场景前馈渲染
papers.tldr: 现有前馈全局光照变换器逐三角形编码，注意力开销随网格规模平方增长，而细分网格并不改变场景的宏观辐射传输。RADIANT以物体为中心，每个物体用32个表面片元令牌表示，并通过几何不变注意力建模物体间光交换，结合点溅射处理主可见性。基于103万场景的评测中，它用少5倍训练步数达到25分贝峰值信噪比，训练60万步达到32.2分贝，较RenderFormer高3.3分贝。该方法将计算规模从多边形数量转向物体数量，实现高效且可扩展的跨场景光照生成。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward neural renderers synthesize global illumination across novel 3D scenes without per-scene optimization or runtime ray tracing. Existing transformer-based renderers tokenize individual triangles, so self-attention scales quadratically with mesh resolution. Yet macroscopic radiative transport is governed by the underlying surface geometry and object arrangements rather than a particular mesh discretization; finer tessellation can thus inflate token counts without changing the underlying transport physics, motivating a discretization-agnostic and object-centric representation. We introduce RADIANT (RADiance-based Inter-Actor Neural Transformer), an object-centric architecture for feed-forward global illumination from point inputs. By representing each object with a compact budget of 32 surface-patch tokens, RADIANT decouples attention sequence length from polygon counts. In a single network, an inter-object scene transformer models 3D radiative exchange and a view decoder renders images at target camera poses. To capture light transport without materializing O(N^2) bias matrices, invariant form-factor attention embeds geometric distances and surface orientations directly into query-key dot products as SE(3)-invariant inner products weighted by learned area and material gains. For primary visibility without mesh connectivity, camera rays cross-attend scene tokens guided by depth-tested point splats in a shared spherical frame. Across a 1.03M-scene benchmark under matched model capacity, RADIANT reaches 25 dB tone-mapped PSNR in 5x fewer training steps than RenderFormer, and achieves 32.2 dB at 600k steps (+3.3 dB over RenderFormer and +7.6 dB over RenderFormer-V2). We further demonstrate the scalability of RADIANT, which completes a 512x512 forward pass of a 500-object scene in 0.83 s, with computational cost scaling with the number of objects rather than polygons.

papers.title_en: SemGeo-Gen: Unsupervised Generation of Approximate Cross-Instance Semantic-Geometric Correspondences
papers.authors: Roy Amoyal, Shira Ifergane, Oren Freifeld
papers.evidence: 从弱对齐三维物体集合生成语义且几何一致的对应监督
papers.tldr: 跨实例三维物体对应往往含糊，精确点级标注成本高，限制了语义对应模型的训练数据规模。SemGeo-Gen利用弱对齐物体集合，将多视角DINOv2特征映射到三维，经分段仿射配准和语义筛选生成近似对应，并投影出三维—三维、三维—二维及二维—二维监督。生成结果在KeypointNet上取得93%的PCK@0.10和97%的PCK@0.15；用于合成预训练后，模型在真实数据微调的SPair-71k上最高提升5个PCK@0.10点。该方法证明三维资产可提供规模化、有效的替代监督，降低人工标注依赖。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SemGeo-Gen, an unsupervised method for generating approximate cross-instance semantic-geometric supervision from weakly aligned 3D object collections. Our goal is not to recover exact point-level correspondences, which are often ambiguous across different instances and would require expensive, impractical manual supervision at scale. Instead, we automatically produce approximate correspondences that are semantically meaningful, geometrically consistent, and diverse enough to train modern correspondence models. Given only coarse category-level rotation alignment, SemGeo-Gen lifts multi-view DINOv2 features to 3D, aligns object instances using continuous piecewise-affine registration, and prunes candidate matches using semantic consistency. The resulting 3D correspondences can be projected into rendered views, yielding scalable 3D-3D, 3D-2D, and 2D-2D supervision without manual annotation. We validate the generated correspondences against sparse human annotations from KeypointNet, obtaining 93% PCK@0.10 and 97% PCK@0.15. More importantly, we show that using the generated correspondences for synthetic pretraining improves recent state-of-the-art semantic correspondence models on SPair-71k after fine-tuning on real data, with gains of up to 5 PCK@0.10 points. Together, these results indicate that approximate semantic-geometric supervision generated from 3D assets can improve real-image correspondence learning and serve as a scalable alternative to costly manual annotation. Project page: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/SemGeo-Gen/.

papers.title_en: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
papers.authors: Philipp Lindenberger, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Ondrej Miksik, Marc Pollefeys
papers.evidence: 学习图像对应关系，为SfM几何恢复提供支撑
papers.tldr: 跨图像对应估计常在稀疏关键点的速度与重复性不足、密集像素的鲁棒性与高开销之间取舍；仅用匹配对训练的方法还容易把具有视觉对称性的无关图像误判为匹配。FlexGlue以第一幅图像中的给定点为输入，在第二幅图像的密集像素中搜索少量对应，并同步判断图像对是否不匹配。该方法兼具亚像素精度和稀疏匹配速度，能高精度拒绝错误图像对。多数据集实验显示其推动相对位姿估计的帕累托前沿，并提升SfM与视觉定位表现。
papers.abstract_en: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive. Furthermore, these approaches are trained with only matching pairs and thus often fail to reject unrelated pairs that exhibit visual symmetries, which is equally important in applications like Structure-from-Motion (SfM). We bridge these gaps by introducing FlexGlue, a neural network for asymmetric sparse-to-dense matching and disambiguation. Given two images and coordinates of points in the first image, FlexGlue estimates the coordinates of the corresponding points in the second image while simultaneously rejecting the pair if non-matching. By searching for a limited set of correspondences among dense pixels, our approach is both fast and effective at both matching and disambiguation: it combines the sub-pixel accuracy of dense matching with the speed of sparse matching, while rejecting incorrect pairs with high precision. Experiments on multiple datasets show that FlexGlue pushes the Pareto frontier in relative pose estimation and significantly outperforms existing approaches for SfM and visual localization. FlexGlue is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/flexglue .
